pages.text: Hot there! Smell that? Fresh-cut spruce, the best smell there is. &6Oswin Fernhollow&r, foraging master, at your service.

&6Foraging&r is trees. Chop logs and you gain &6Foraging XP&r. Different woods want better axes: hard ones like ironbark need iron at the very least. Plant a sapling for every tree you fell, and the woods will love you back.
Logs also hide rare finds, like Heartwood Splinters. Bring me &6Heartwood Bundles&r and I'll make you gear, and from level ten, an owl egg. Here's an axe. Mabel's at the fields. Go on.
